1 Expert - Substrate & Packaging Industrialization In your role, you will be responsible for the evaluation and transfer of integration approaches for components requiring high-precision alignment within substrate and packaging environments. The role focuses on assessing feasibility under realistic production conditions and contributes to the development and realization of integration approaches. The position contributes to building and validating integration processes through hands-on experimental work and process development, ensuring that concepts can be translated into stable and scalable solutions. 

Your responsibilities 
 * Evaluate integration approaches for components requiring high-precision alignment within substrate and manufacturing environments 
 * Assess compatibility of proposed approaches with existing process capabilities, materials, and infrastructure 
 * Contribute to the development and realization of integration approaches within prototyping and process development activities 
 * Identify process limitations, critical tolerances, and integration constraints affecting implementation 
 * Support and execute experimental work, including design of experiments (DoE), to validate approaches under realistic conditions 
 * Identify and understand process sensitivities and critical parameters affecting stability and yield 
 * Iteratively refine processes based on experimental results and learnings 
 * Contribute to the identification of required process adaptations, capability gaps, and infrastructure needs 
 * Support internal decision-making by providing feasibility assessments and technical input, participate in internal and external technical discussions related to process integration 
 * Contribute to definition of implementation pathways for new technologies 

Your profile 
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Electronics, or a related technical field 
 * Several years (typically 5+ years) of experience in substrate, PCB, or advanced packaging manufacturing or process development environments 
 * Experience working across R&D, engineering, experimental work and design of experiments (DoE), and production interfaces in a collaborative environment 
 * Experience in IC substrate manufacturing, HDI technologies, integration or prototyping is an advantage
 * Strong understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes in substrate or packaging environments 
 * Ability to translate technical concepts into feasible and stable process solutions under real production conditions 
 * Understanding of process sensitivities, tolerances, and material interactions in high-precision assemblies 
 * Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented way of working with a focus on implementation
 * Fluency in English

1 Customer Care Executive (m/f/x) / Bilingual - German and English
 Thaur, Tirol  full-time (40h/week)

Your Mission
As a Customer Care Executive, you will be the first point of contact for our customers, providing exceptional service in both German and English. You will be responsible for addressing customer inquiries, resolving issues and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. Your role will involve written communication, and you will play a crucial role in maintaining positive relationships with our diverse customer base. You will also work closely with our supplier partners, particularly in the areas of carrier services and returns management. This is an exciting opportunity to become part of our dynamic, customer-focused Innsbruck team where your contributions will directly impact the customer experience.

What You'll Be Doing
*  Customer Support: Provide high-quality support to customers via email in both English and German.
*  Issue Resolution: Handle customer complaints, questions, and feedback, ensuring timely and accurate resolutions.
*  Order Management: Process orders, returns, and exchanges, and ensure proper documentation and communication.
*  Supplier Collaboration: Work closely with carrier and returns partners to ensure the efficient and timely processing of shipments, returns and resolving any issues that may arise.
*  Product Information: Provide detailed product information and guidance, ensuring customers make informed purchasing decisions.
*  Follow-Up: Follow up with customers as needed to ensure satisfaction and resolve any ongoing concerns - including bank claims.
*  Database Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records in the system.
*  Team Collaboration: Work closely with other departments (e.g., IT, Logistics) to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Who You Are
You are a reliable and organized professional with a keen eye for detail. You have
*  Fluency in German and English (both written and spoken) is a must.

*  Ability to handle high-volume customer interactions while maintaining a calm and professional demeanour.
*   Proficient in using customer support software and tools (e.g., Zendesk)
*  Attention to detail and a strong organisational ability.

*  Knowledge of additional languages is a plus.

*  A solution-focused approach.
*  Familiarity with the apparel/ nutrition industry is a bonus.
*  Multitasking ability: Comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritising
*  effectively in a busy environment.
*  Data analysis skills: Ability to interpret customer feedback or data to inform decision-making and improve customer care processes.
*  Adaptability: Capable of adjusting to new systems, processes, and customer needs with ease, maintaining a positive attitude.

What We Offer
